method: Original JPG is source truth. SelectedPNG resized to each original native dimensions using Lanczos. Lower body boundaries: median RGB strip across15%-85% width, signed edge profile, then8 x-column strip edge validation. Upper body boundaries:6 constrained x-column edge profiles around physical ribbon boundaries to exclude letters and gold backgrounds. Natural irregularity retained. Coordinates top-left origin; positive deltas downward/rightward. Precision2-3px vertically; horizontal estimate10px uncertain. Whole-canvas affine fits ALL4 body edges; transforms not yet applied.

criterion.meaning: Operational tolerance in original native pixel units, not exact pixel identity or unchanged outlines. For strict original layout, inspect corrected beforeafter before JPEG.
